purpose: Zero-update six-second TRAIN integration probes before initialization decision; not full skidpad scores
decision: Require finite complete source-bound evidence and stateful action audit. Exclude any initialization with an integration failure. Compare early contacts descriptively only. Select vision_e59 if eligible to preserve its existing Isaac appearance adaptation; apply the explicit physical-consistency objective rather than selecting the already regressed latest policy. Original remains the unadapted reference. No validation caps will be loosened.
training_objective: plan NLL plus native-relative endpoint-acceleration consistency; no teacher actuator command objective
coefficient_recipe: Use w_consistency=1.0. Frozen TRAIN-only gradient diagnostic on e59 measured consistency gradient norms 36.77 to 51.84 versus plan 50.09 to 51.26 and cosine 0.0135 to 0.0330. This gives comparable raw gradient norms without a validation-tuned coefficient.
optimization: 500 policy updates with frozen vision, batch128,16 qualified recovery draws,history8,FP32; same optimizer schedule as prior run
qualification: Existing absolute action and plan-coherence caps remain. Rank eligible checkpoints by strict plan-L1 improvement over step zero. If no checkpoint qualifies, report rejection and evaluate the final diagnostic checkpoint without promotion.
